slice 2 gradients: linearGradient/radialGradient via url(#id) with gradientUnits, gradientTransform, spreadMethod, href chain inheritance (depth 8, cycles refused, local only), stop offset/stop-color/stop-opacity (style or attribute), percent lengths, one stop = solid, no stops / degenerate bbox / singular transform = typed loss; Paint::{Solid,Linear,Radial} with the final gradient-space -> document-pt transform (bbox mapping folded in)

notes.tests_tree: 9 focused tests pass (5 slice-1 + 4 slice-2 including the decompression-bomb test); clippy --tests --examples clean for this crate; shared edit tree at f0cdb55 (other lanes may have uncommitted edits)
notes.api_change_slice2: StyleProposal.fill/stroke replaced by items: Vec<AppearanceItem> (fills()/strokes() helpers); StrokePaint removed; Limits gains max_decompressed_bytes; Provenance gains decoded_len; VectorError gains Gzip(&str); the slice-1 paint-server test now uses a pattern as the unsupported server because gradients are supported
notes.folio_need: Folio has no paint, gradient, stroke-style or appearance-row types: StudioGradient (STU-RAS-160), fill kinds (STU-VEC-134), stroke entries (STU-VEC-020, 143-145) and the appearance stack (STU-VEC-022, STU-DS-034b) are crate-local in hsk-studio-interop-vector::model until the PAINT/style owner lands them; layer opacity already maps to Folio LayerAppearance. Spec gaps: dash phase (stroke-dashoffset) is not in STU-VEC-145; gradient stop midpoints (STU-VEC-136) have no SVG counterpart; per-row opacity, blend and visibility (STU-VEC-015) are not expressible per row in SVG, so opacity is folded into alpha and the rest is not carried
notes.gradient_model: Paint keeps gradient parameters in gradient space plus one affine to document points; objectBoundingBox is converted exactly with the tight bbox of the element geometry (curve extrema), so `units` is provenance only; export always writes userSpaceOnUse with the full matrix
notes.nib_dependency: nib OwnedPath (SMB-NIB-ENG-1) landed; used via OwnedPath::from_anchors in VectorPath::to_geometry
notes.folio_note: folio StudioLayer gained text_frame (other lane); this crate sets text_frame: None
design_choices: no allow_external field on ImportPolicy: no code path fetches anything, so a switch that can only be false would mislead
element opacity lives only in Folio LayerAppearance; fill and stroke opacity are folded into paint alpha (gradient stops included)
compound SVG path = several VectorPath sharing layer_id (one Payload::Vector layer lists all ids); UNVERIFIED whether that carries compound fill-rule hole semantics
Winding::None encodes fill none (nib: no fill); the fill-rule of an unfilled path is not kept
closing curve whose end equals the first anchor is merged into the first anchor's incoming handle (Illustrator storage)

SVGZ: one gzip member only; the decompressed payload is never unwrapped again; input cap max_bytes applies to the compressed bytes
